hook: Don't let the giant floating seal fool you: this is a long, character-driven story about burnout and the fear of never measuring up. It is told through transcripts and a guided tour of one man's past, and it swings between silly and sincere very quickly. Give it time; the jokes are doing setup work.
whyItMatters:
The story leans on a large cast of named directors and doctors who clearly share history, plus a crude, loud-mouthed gumball machine, SCP-5595, sitting in on staff meetings. Much of the comedy comes from that ensemble talking over each other.

It is also an unusual take on the helpful-entity idea, closer to a redemption story than a containment report: the seal writes its own file and asks only to spend a day with a Site Director.
thingsToNotice:
The structure loops. Lague's opening line to Cimmerian, cut off by the seal's appearance, returns twice near the end: once as the angry version that leads to disaster, once as the relieved version after the journey. In between, the SEEKER machine he builds to prove himself keeps finding cannibals, from a Phillie Phanatic-style creature to a child-eating time traveller and an adult-eating Tickle-Me-Elmo, while a contented spaghetti cowboy asks him straight out whether he is happy with himself.

The white book with its back cover burnt away holds the ending he was headed for: he pushes SEEKER past its limits, it melts down, and Site-322, his people and he himself are gone, leaving a sulphurous crater. The seal, Wallace, pulled him out just before, and the empty shelves fill with white, unwritten books only when he finally says he trusts himself. Back in the loop he apologizes, admits the slump began after his 001 proposal, and dials SEEKER down to a single universe, where it finds the seal in the sky above the Site. The short description at the end mirrors the opening one, and the early 'memory thing' and the odd line about it being one of two living beings on Earth both read differently once you know where Lague was taken from.

related.note: The heckling gumball machine that sits in on Lague's intervention.
